_doc: data/cause_map.json — the authored join between the site's TWO cause taxonomies.
data/cause_learn.json has 224 `why.causes` (what the protocol page's accordion lists, ranked by
leverage). The two files share no key — scanning every why.cause field against the 52 root-cause
ids gives 0 matches — so the protocol page had no way to know which of its 4-7 causes its own URL
was about, and app.js hard-coded the accordion open on index 0 for all 52 URLs.
Shape: problem id -> root_cause id -> the EXACT `name` of the why.cause that root cause is about,
or null when no single authored cause corresponds (see `unmapped`, which must then carry the
reason). Keyed by NAME, not index, so re-ranking or inserting a cause can never silently repoint
a mapping — assertCauseMap() in build/parse.js fails the build instead.
Every value was adjudicated by reading the root cause's own name/plain/diagnostic against each
cause's name and tell.symptoms. 27 of 52 resolve to the rank-1 cause (today's behaviour, now
written down so it is auditable rather than inherited); 20 change which cause opens; 5 are
deliberately unmapped and fall back to rank 1 unchanged.
NOT clinical review. No clinician or other authoritative professional has reviewed this file, and
nothing in it may be presented as reviewed by a person. It is an editorial join between two
authored text corpora, and every entry is traceable to the wording of those corpora.

knee-pain.patellofemoral-pain: Hip & quad weakness with patellofemoral pain

low-back-pain.weak-posterior-chain: Deconditioning + all-day sitting (weak posterior chain, tight hips)
low-back-pain.poor-core-stability: Poor motor control / core stability (the back that 'tweaks')

hip-mobility.glute-weakness: Hip-flexor dominance & glute weakness from sitting

insulin-resistance.poor-glucose-disposal: Physical inactivity (the muscle glucose sink powered down)
insulin-resistance.visceral-adiposity: Visceral & ectopic fat (fat spilling into liver and muscle)

blood-pressure.endothelial-sodium: Salt-sensitivity: high sodium, low potassium + endothelial nitric-oxide deficit

shift-work.circadian-desync: Central clock (SCN) misalignment from mistimed light

low-testosterone.lifestyle-suppressed-t: Visceral obesity / metabolic syndrome (obesity-related secondary hypogonadism)
low-testosterone.primary-hypogonadism: Testicular or pituitary failure, incl. anabolic-steroid-induced (clinical primary or organic secondary hypogonadism)

menopause.estrogen-decline: Vasomotor instability (hot flushes & night sweats) — hypothalamic KNDy hyperactivity

acne.sebum-insulin: Insulin / IGF-1 diet axis (high-glycemic carbs + dairy)

longevity.cellular-senescence: Mitochondrial decline, NAD+ depletion & cellular senescence

immunity.micronutrient-immune: Micronutrient gaps (vitamin D, zinc, vitamin C)

hypertrophy.stimulus-recovery: Stalled progressive overload (stimulus no longer increasing)

strength-plateau.neural-recovery: Accumulated fatigue masking fitness (no deload / overreaching)

fat-loss-plateau.metabolic-adaptation: Adherence drift / calorie creep (the deficit quietly closed)

endurance-plateau.aerobic-base: Stale, monotonous training (gray-zone drift + no progressive overload)

overtraining.autonomic-imbalance: Autonomic imbalance from training-load monotony (no deload / no periodisation)

unmapped.thyroid/subclinical-hypothyroid: Root cause 'Sluggish thyroid / nutrient deficits': the first half restates the problem, and 'nutrient deficits' spans three separate authored causes (#2 iodine, #3 selenium, #4 iron/ferritin) while naming none of them. No single cause corresponds.
unmapped.brain-fog/neuroinflammation: Root cause 'Neuroinflammation / poor metabolic control': the only cause containing 'neuroinflammation' is #5 'Chronic / post-viral neuroinflammation', whose tell (started after an infection, worse for a day or two after exertion) contradicts this root cause's own diagnostic, 'worse after poor sleep or high-sugar meals' — which points at #1 sleep debt and #3 blood-sugar swings. The name and the diagnostic point at different causes, so no join is asserted. Needs an editorial decision.
unmapped.low-mood/monoamine-inflammation: Root cause 'Low monoamines + inflammation' is a mechanism composite. No authored cause names monoamines; 'inflammation' matches only #4 'Inflammatory / sickness-behavior depression', whose tell (leaden fatigue, belly fat, raised CRP) is not implied by this root cause's diagnostic, which restates the problem (persistent low mood, anhedonia, low drive).
unmapped.inflammation/low-grade-inflammation: Root cause 'Chronic low-grade inflammation' is the problem's own name, and its diagnostic (elevated CRP, aches, slow recovery) is the problem definition rather than a driver. The six authored causes ARE its drivers; picking one would assert a diagnosis the text does not make.
unmapped.pre-workout/low-readiness: Root cause 'Low training readiness' is an umbrella over all six authored causes (under-fuelling, sleep debt, accumulated fatigue, caffeine tolerance, dehydration, low ferritin) and its diagnostic ('flat, unmotivated, underperforming sessions') is the problem restated.

notes.hip-mobility/glute-weakness: Two clauses of the diagnostic ('poor single-leg control, knee caves in on squats') and the root cause's own name match #3 'Hip-flexor dominance & glute weakness from sitting' verbatim; the third clause ('lateral hip ache') belongs to #1 gluteal tendinopathy. Mapped on the two-clause majority plus the verbatim name match.
notes.insulin-resistance/poor-glucose-disposal: 'Poor glucose disposal / inactivity' -> #2 'Physical inactivity (the muscle glucose sink powered down)': both halves of the root-cause name appear in that one cause. #1 visceral fat is taken by this problem's other root cause, visceral-adiposity.
notes.skin-aging/collagen-loss-glycation: 'Collagen loss + glycation' spans #2 (intrinsic chronological aging / fibroblast senescence) and #3 (dietary glycation). Mapped to #2 on the leading term of both the name ('collagen loss') and the diagnostic ('fine lines, loss of firmness'). #1 'UV photoaging' is taken by this problem's other root cause, uv-oxidative.
notes.strength-plateau/neural-recovery: 'Neural efficiency + recovery limits', diagnostic 'top lifts stuck; grinding reps, poor recovery' -> #2 'Accumulated fatigue masking fitness'. Not #1: #1's own tell explicitly requires that you 'feel fully recovered with good sleep, appetite and motivation', which contradicts this root cause's diagnostic.
notes.immunity/micronutrient-immune: 'Micronutrient gaps / immune resilience' -> #2 'Micronutrient gaps (vitamin D, zinc, vitamin C)' — verbatim name match, and #2's tell ('a cold hangs around for weeks instead of clearing') matches the diagnostic's 'slow recovery'.
notes.anxiety/gaba-deficit: 'Low GABAergic tone / over-arousal' -> #5 'Low GABAergic tone / magnesium-glutamate imbalance' — verbatim on the leading term, and #5's tell (permanent low hum of tension, tight muscles, mind that won't switch off) matches the diagnostic (racing thoughts, tension, trouble winding down).
notes.insomnia/circadian-misalign: Composite: 'circadian misalignment' -> #2, 'hyperarousal' -> #1. Mapped to #1 'Cognitive-somatic hyperarousal' because the diagnostic leads with "can't switch off at night", which is #1's tell.
notes.sleep-maintenance/cortisol-glucose-night: Composite: 'nighttime cortisol' -> #1, 'glucose swings' -> #3. Mapped to #1 'Stress-driven hyperarousal', whose tell ('wake in the small hours feeling switched-on') matches the diagnostic ('wake at 3-4am, hard to fall back asleep').
notes.low-testosterone/lifestyle-suppressed-t: The diagnostic names three lifestyle drivers (overweight #1, poor sleep #2, high stress #3). Mapped to #1 'Visceral obesity / metabolic syndrome', which the diagnostic names first and which is the highest-leverage of the three. This problem's other root cause, primary-hypogonadism, takes #5.
notes.fat-loss-plateau/metabolic-adaptation: Both halves of the name are verbatim causes (#1 'Adherence drift / calorie creep', #3 'Metabolic adaptation'). Mapped to #1 because the diagnostic — 'weight loss stalled despite "the same" diet' — is #1's tell verbatim.
notes.hypertrophy/stimulus-recovery: Composite ('insufficient stimulus' -> #1, 'or recovery' -> #3). Mapped to #1 'Stalled progressive overload', whose tell (logbook identical to two months ago) matches the diagnostic.
notes.endurance-plateau/aerobic-base: Composite ('thin aerobic base' -> #1 stale/monotonous training, 'iron status' -> #4). Mapped to #1 on the leading clause of the diagnostic ('pace/HR not improving').
